hook: If you've never smoked, you're not off the hook.
caption: HPV is now the leading cause of oral cancer in adults under 50, and most people who develop it have no history of tobacco use. The risk is real, and it doesn't fit the profile most people picture. Knowing where the actual risk comes from is the first step toward catching anything early. Take the free screener at oralcheck.org.
